name: La Granja (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical stripes, green at the hoist and white with three blue horizontal stripes at the fly.
history: The arms and the flag of La Granja were approved by the Order of 15 May 2000 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 25 May 2000, approved by the Consejera de Presidencia María Antonia Trujillo after the municipal council's approval on 18 December 1997; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two equal vertical stripes, green next to the staff and white with three horizontal blue stripes at the fly.

features.role: three horizontal stripes on the white fly
